name: Forfexopterus
sum: Scissor-jawed ctenochasmatid from the Early Cretaceous Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning, China.
wsnote: Holotype (subadult) revised to 2.37 m; an adult wing specimen gives 1.78 m.
holotype: HM V20 (Hami Museum) — Jiufotang Formation, Liaoning.
material: Mostly complete skeleton with skull (51 cm), missing much of the vertebral column; plus an articulated wing (SDUST V1003) and a jaw tip.
biology: Long, low skull with slender outward-pointing teeth but no spatulate tip or crest; growth rates varied between individuals.
author: Jiang et al. 2016

species.name: Forfexopterus jeholensis
